prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Try Pet Controls Demo"]
1: ["Upload High Quality Photos for Best Pet Result", "Choose Photos", "Pet Render Preview"]
2: ["Test Pet Desktop Presence & Overlay", "Test Pet Desktop Spawn", "Click to verify your pet appears on screen and near taskbar"]
3: ["Select Your Ideal Desktop Pet Companion", "Preview pet behaviors before finalizing adoption"]
4: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Desktop Pet", "Ensure you use your primary account so your adopted pets and progress sync seamlessly without losing data.", "Signing into a different account may hide current local pet files."]
5: ["Select How You Want to Experience Your Desktop Pet", "Choose between quick instant preset adoption or full custom AI pet creation."]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Workspace", "Building 3D pet model and animations", "Configuring desktop overlay permissions"]
7: ["Right-click pet for menu, double-click to talk, drag to move across desktop monitors.", "Pro Tip: Right Click = Pet Menu", "Pro Tip: Double Click = Talk Mode"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Play Pet Greeting Sound"]
9: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives directly on your desktop screen, reacts to your work, and keeps you company.", "Get Started"]
